currentParagraphText: “What would you have done if I’d raised a fuss or complained?”

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “What would you have done if I’d raised a fuss or complained?”
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “I knew you wouldn’t,” the Godqueen smiled. “Even if every single meal had comprised only mushrooms and moss, you wouldn’t have said anything. You might have been unable to hide your dissatisfaction, but if Solana asked you directly if you enjoyed the meal, you would have forced a smile and nodded.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Sure did,” Artemis nodded, bereft of shame.
